verdict.rationale: Bolna's agent API is explicitly URL-versioned at /v2, and it publishes dated monthly changelogs covering API updates. REST deprecations, however, are only handled ad hoc through migration guides, and the versioning-and-support policy page covers only the CLI, with no stated commitment window for the API. Missing for 10: a documented REST API deprecation policy with notice/sunset windows, a published machine-readable versioned spec, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The agent API surface is explicitly URL-versioned at /v2 (POST /v2/agent, GET /v2/agent/:agent_id and the rest of the v2 endpoint catalog).
Bolna publishes dated monthly changelogs covering features and API updates (December 2024 through the current month).
REST deprecations are documented ad hoc through migration guides (e.g. the legacy post-call extraction removal)
